# Swizzle

> The first tiki bar in Laos. Tropical cocktails built on Lao spirits and fruit, hidden inside Noy's Fruit Heaven near Pha That Luang, Vientiane.

Swizzle is a tiki bar near Pha That Luang in Vientiane, Laos, run by the family behind Noy's Fruit Heaven. Contact: aloha@swizzle.la, +856 20 55 396 898. Sister sites: https://www.noysfruitheaven.com (fresh fruit shakes), https://play.noysfruitheaven.com (Noy's Fruit Run, a free game).

## Visit

- [Swizzle · Tiki Bar in Vientiane, Laos · Tropical Cocktails](https://swizzle.la/): The first tiki bar in Laos. Tropical cocktails built on Lao spirits and fruit, hidden inside Noy's Fruit Heaven near Pha That Luang, Vientiane.
- [Swizzle Menu · Tiki Cocktails and Lao Food, Vientiane](https://swizzle.la/menu/): The full Swizzle menu: Lao tiki cocktails, Don the Beachcomber classics, sharing bowls, zero-proof drinks, Lao food from the fire, wine, Beerlao and soft drinks. All prices in Lao kip.

## The Swizzle Journal

- [The Swizzle Journal · Tales from a Lao Tiki Bar](https://swizzle.la/blog/): The Swizzle Journal: stories from a Lao tiki bar in Vientiane, cocktail history, Polynesian culture, and the people and objects behind the bar.
- [The Best Cocktail Bars in Vientiane (2026): Where to Drink Well in the Capital · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/best-cocktail-bars-in-vientiane/): The best cocktail bars in Vientiane, chosen by people who make drinks for a living: Cocoon, Gallery 38, 525, Madame at the Lao Poet, Artisan, Sona. Where each one is, what it is like, and the one thing to order.
- [The Best Tiki Bars in the World (2026): 15 Bars Worth the Flight · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/best-tiki-bars-in-the-world/): The best tiki bars in the world, ranked by people who make the drinks: Smuggler's Cove, Latitude 29, the Mai-Kai, Tiki-Ti, Tropic City and more. Where to drink tiki properly in 2026, from San Francisco to Bangkok.
- [The Man Who Invented an Island · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/don-the-beachcomber/): Donn Beach: bootlegger, storyteller, and the inventor of the tiki bar. The true story of Don the Beachcomber.
- [Four Gods and a Carving Knife · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/gods-of-the-carved-face/): Kū, Kāne, Lono and Kanaloa: the Hawaiian gods behind the carved faces, and what the word tiki actually means.
- [From Navy Grog to the Zombie · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/short-history-of-tiki-cocktails/): A short history of tiki cocktails: grog, planter's punch, the golden age, the dark years, and the revival that reached Vientiane.
- [The Drink That Named the Bar · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/the-swizzle-story/): Why our bar is called Swizzle: the story of the Caribbean swizzle stick, the bois lélé tree, and the coldest drinks in the tropics.
- [Totems, Mugs and the Spirits That Hold Your Drink · Swizzle](https://swizzle.la/blog/totems-and-mugs/): From temple guardians to the ceramic tiki mug: how carved faces travelled from sacred posts to the bar top.
- [The Man Who Sold the Island · The Swizzle Journal](https://swizzle.la/blog/trader-vic/): Victor Bergeron: Oakland beer-parlour owner, inventor of the Mai Tai, and the man who turned the tiki bar into an empire. The true story of Trader Vic.

## The Archive

- [The Archive · Swizzle Tiki Bar, Vientiane](https://swizzle.la/archive/): Provenance and rights records for the historical material in the Swizzle Journal: what each object is, who holds it, and why we may show it.
- [Provenance: Don the Beachcomber menu, 1941 · Swizzle Archive](https://swizzle.la/archive/beachcomber-menu-1943/): A copyright-renewal search on the 1941 Don the Beachcomber menu, CHS2014.1476, and the reasoning behind the public domain determination.
- [Provenance: Monitor-Leader, 14 August 1945 · Swizzle Archive](https://swizzle.la/archive/monitor-leader-1945/): A copyright renewal search on the 1945 Monitor-Leader Zombie column: the newspaper never renewed, but the article is syndicated NEA copy that was.
